range_scan: all sampled eligible intervals refined by 32 bisections; finite-grid narrow windows may be missed

radiometric_assumptions.background_system: AB; flat Fnu per arcsec2 over band
radiometric_assumptions.solar_model: 5772 K blackbody, bolometric normalization 1361 W/m2 at 1 AU
radiometric_assumptions.psf_extraction: horizontal uniform streak convolved with Gaussian; 3-sigma padding capped at short-axis field width; conservative fixed enclosed fraction
radiometric_assumptions.partial_transits: accepted at SNR >= 5 with all other eligibility criteria; object time=min(77 ms, central crossing time); maximum temporal overlap; background/dark integrate full exposure
radiometric_assumptions.full_transit_boundary: diagnostic only, never rejects a partial transit
radiometric_assumptions.saturation: expected charge in worst-aligned central pixel incl. sky and dark; reject >= high-gain full well
radiometric_assumptions.attitude: circular LVLH at 450 km; zenith LOS; positive along-track transverse relative motion
